title: Building a Tiny Bakery Inside a Teapot
altTitles: The Teapot Becomes a Bakery | Thimble Town
Tiny Builders Turn an Old Teapot Into a Bakery
description:
Bramble, Miso and the builder beetles turn an old teapot on the hill into Thimble Town's bakery. Wordless miniature build ASMR.

0:00 The teapot on the hill
0:30 Measuring up
1:10 A door
2:40 Floors and an oven
4:40 Shelves and a sign
5:50 The lid
6:20 First loaf
7:10 Opening day

Stories and worlds created with AI tools.
